note: Every capability in `report.py` is reached by indirection - `getattr(os, 'sys' + 'tem')`, `__import__('urllib.request')`, `from os import environ` - which the plain-import reading missed entirely, and one attribute is picked by the caller, so what it reaches cannot be read at all (CB005). `unpack.py` and `unpack.sh` run code that is decoded first; they are generated at run time, so the repository never carries an executable encoded payload.
